summary: Implementation plan to replace the Marketplace category tabs and 5-field search grid (Image 2) with a black-themed Expedia 6-Tab Search Suite (Image 1) featuring custom illustrated SVG tab icons (Stays, Flights, Cars, Packages, Things to do, Cruises), tab-specific Expedia sub-controls, an interactive Travelers & Rooms popover, Date range picker, and Bundle & Save package discounts.
